stories.title: Troisième de l’Ironman d’Hawaï, Julie Derron va-t-elle persévérer sur les triathlons de longue distance?

en.title: Third at Hawaii's Ironman, will Julie Derron continue with long-distance triathlons?
en.summary: Swiss triathlete Julie Derron finished third at the Hawaii Ironman following her silver medal at Paris 2024 Olympics. She must decide whether to pursue ultra-distance racing before the Los Angeles 2028 Games.

stories.title: Donald Trump annonce un cessez-le-feu entre la Russie et l'Ukraine sur l'énergie, Kiev conditionne son accord à celui de Moscou

en.title: Donald Trump announces ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine on energy, Kyiv conditions its agreement on Moscow's approval
en.summary: President Trump announced a ceasefire agreement on energy infrastructure between Russia and Ukraine that took immediate effect, though Ukrainian President Zelensky quickly contradicted this claim while remaining open to such an agreement if Russia agrees.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: Wolodimir Selenski stellt Bedingungen für Neuwahlen +++ Donald Trump verkündet begrenzte Waffenruhe

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: Volodymyr Zelensky sets conditions for new elections +++ Donald Trump announces limited ceasefire
en.summary: Russia has been at war with Ukraine for over four years. A live ticker provides an overview of major developments in the Russia-Ukraine conflict.

stories.title: «Ein Tag wie eine Achterbahn»: Julie Derron wird bei ihrem Hawaii-Debüt an der Ironman-Weltmeisterschaft Dritte

en.title: "A day like a roller coaster": Julie Derron finishes third at her Hawaii debut at the Ironman World Championship
en.summary: Julie Derron placed third in her debut at the Ironman World Championship in Hawaii. The legendary race demonstrated that victory goes not to the fittest athlete, but to the one whose body endures the extreme demands.

stories.title: Entdeckt im frühen Stadium – Knoten in der Lunge: Papst wird operiert

en.title: Discovered in Early Stage – Lung Nodule: Pope to Undergo Surgery
en.summary: The Pope announced that a lung nodule was detected at an early stage and requires surgical intervention. The procedure is scheduled to take place in the coming days.

stories.title: «Knoten in der Lunge»: Papst muss operiert werden

en.title: Lung Nodule: Pope Must Undergo Surgery
en.summary: The Pope requires surgery for a lung nodule, with the operation scheduled to occur within the next several days according to his statement.

stories.title: En images – L'Espagne démonte le dernier grand campement de migrants à Ceuta

en.title: In Images – Spain Dismantles Last Major Migrant Camp in Ceuta
en.summary: Spanish authorities dismantled a large emergency camp in the North African enclave ahead of a royal visit, following a major migrant influx in July that caused numerous deaths.

stories.title: L'Espagne démantèle le dernier camp de migrants à Ceuta avant la visite du roi

en.title: Spain Dismantles Last Migrant Camp in Ceuta Before King's Visit
en.summary: Spanish authorities dismantled the final large emergency camp in Ceuta on Sunday, housing migrants who arrived in July, days before a royal visit.

stories.title: Le trafic ferroviaire entre Lausanne et Yverdon a repris ce dimanche matin

en.title: Rail Traffic Between Lausanne and Yverdon Resumed Sunday Morning
en.summary: The Yverdon-Lausanne rail line resumed normal service Sunday after a criminal fire disrupted it since Friday, requiring replacement buses and affecting numerous train services.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Trump verkündet Angriffsstopp auf Energieanlagen

en.title: War in Ukraine – Trump Announces Attack Halt on Energy Facilities
en.summary: US President Trump announced that Moscow and Kyiv have agreed to cease attacks on energy infrastructure as part of developments in the Ukraine conflict.

stories.title: Le trafic CFF Yverdon-Lausanne a repris dimanche matin après l'incendie criminel

en.title: CFF traffic Yverdon-Lausanne resumed Sunday morning after arson
en.summary: Rail service between Yverdon-les-Bains and Lausanne resumed normal operations Sunday morning following a criminal fire. CFF strongly condemned the arson attack and announced it would file a report.

stories.title: "L'Ukraine doit avoir un nouveau président": Donald Trump appelle à remplacer Volodymr Zelensky

en.title: "Ukraine must have a new president": Donald Trump calls for replacing Volodymyr Zelensky
en.summary: Donald Trump criticized Volodymyr Zelensky, stating it was time for Ukraine to have a new president. He urged Zelensky to stop striking Russian oil refineries following a diesel agreement reached with Moscow.

stories.title: Eine Gruppe wollte den Skibetrieb in Braunwald retten – doch ihr Übernahmeangebot blieb unbeantwortet

en.title: A Group Wanted to Save Ski Operations in Braunwald – But Their Takeover Offer Went Unanswered
en.summary: An initiative attempted to purchase the main shareholder's stake in Braunwald's ski facilities to prevent closure of traditional ski operations. The shareholder did not respond to the offer, leaving the takeover attempt unsuccessful.

stories.title: Der Franken ist weiterhin ein sicherer Hafen – dies zeigen die Sorgen über Frankreich und eine mögliche Euro-Schuldenkrise

en.title: The franc remains a safe haven – concerns about France and a potential euro debt crisis demonstrate this
en.summary: The franc has weakened slightly against the euro in recent months but remains a safe haven. Private investors should exercise caution with investments in other currencies or hedge currency risk.

stories.title: Die Stadt Rafah gibt es nicht mehr

en.title: The city of Rafah no longer exists
en.summary: More than two years after an Israeli military operation in the Gaza Strip city, nearly all buildings including schools, mosques, and homes have been destroyed, with satellite imagery showing the area as rubble.

stories.title: Von der Schweiz schwärmen und dafür bezahlt werden: Nina Chuba übernimmt das Privileg von Roger Federer

en.title: Praising Switzerland and getting paid for it: Nina Chuba takes over the privilege of Roger Federer
en.summary: German artist Nina Chuba has been hired to promote Swiss autumn holidays for a fee, following in the footsteps of retired ambassador Roger Federer who now resides in Rapperswil-Jona.

stories.title: Schweizer Online-Giganten bezweifeln, dass sich die KI-Agenten fürs Shopping durchsetzen werden

en.title: Swiss online giants doubt that AI shopping agents will catch on
en.summary: Galaxus and Brack are preparing for digital shopping assistants, but they question whether such AI agents will achieve widespread adoption in Switzerland.
